pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hybrid hotel east of Kraków’s Old Town, offering private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and a game zone.

Family and budget stay

Choose a private family room with the exact bed layout and occupancy your household needs. The hotel lists a shared guest kitchen and game zone. Confirm cot availability, kitchen equipment and access arrangements for your booking.

The Grzegórzki location is east of the Old Town. Plan your routes and compare the total private-room cost with taxes, breakfast, parking and other extras. A bed in a shared dorm is a different booking product.

Firsthand family review

Keri Stooksbury’s Upgraded Points family-stay review was first published on 26 February 2024 and later updated. It describes the family room, shared facilities and the game zone enjoyed by her children. Its historical room price and savings comparison are not current offers.

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot contains 60 reviews and gives Service 3.4/5. Read recent comments on service and noise before deciding whether the social hotel-and-hostel atmosphere suits your household.

Opening

The operator’s October 2023 launch account records 135 rooms and 507 beds. A precise opening day has not been verified. The date of this pin is the review publication milestone, rather than an invented opening day.

Acclaim 0 for these checked guide selections, not a claim about every design award. AAA country program excludes Poland.

pin.longFormSummary:
A LEGO-themed family hotel opposite LEGOLAND Japan, with themed bedrooms, treasure hunts and hotel play spaces in Nagoya’s Kinjo-futo district.

Family rooms and play

The current room list includes 30 m² Standard and Premium rooms for four guests and Premium Plus rooms for five, with an additional child’s bed. Some 45 m² suites list five or six guests depending on their playroom or living-room configuration. Confirm the exact room category, bed layout and occupancy before booking.

Hotel information lists children’s play space and a Water Play Area that requires reservations. Check availability, activity access and the current booking rules for your stay.

This is a park-focused stay in Kinjo-futo, outside central Nagoya. Compare the selected package carefully: breakfast and park-ticket arrangements depend on the published plan, and historic guest-review inclusions are not a promise for every booking.

Review context

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot has 162 reviews. Guests describe themed rooms and treasure hunts; the location is convenient for LEGOLAND but requires planning for trips elsewhere in Nagoya. Compare recent dining, service and room-layout comments with your family’s needs.

Opening

The operator confirms that LEGOLAND Japan Hotel grand-opened on 28 April 2018. The adjacent park and SEA LIFE aquarium have separate opening milestones.
